task.description: The Pixi task name to execute

environment.description: Optional environment in which to execute the task

pixi.executablePath.description: Path to the Pixi executable (supports relative paths and ${workspaceFolder}). Leave empty to use auto-discovery.

pixi.environmentRules.description: Rules to map glob patterns to Pixi environment names (format: 'pattern=env' or 'pattern:env', e.g. 'tests/**=dev', 'train/**=train'). Click 'Add Item' to add rules.

pixi.displayNameFormat.description: Format template for environment display names. Supported placeholders: ${project} (or {{project}}), ${env}, ${version} (or {{version}}).

enumDescriptions: Always prompt to choose between pixi.toml and pyproject.toml
pixi.defaultManifestFormat.description: Default manifest format when initializing a new Pixi project.

enumDescriptions: Prompt to install uninstalled Pixi environments when opening a project
Automatically install uninstalled environments in the background
Never prompt or automatically install environments on open
pixi.autoInstallOnOpen.description: Control automatic environment installation when opening a Pixi project with uninstalled environments.

pixi.terminal.defaultEnvironment.description: Default environment name to activate when opening a Pixi terminal (e.g. 'default' or 'dev'). If empty, prompts for selection when multiple environments exist.

pixi.packageSearch.includePypi.description: Include PyPI packages in package search results.

enumDescriptions: Group transitive dependencies under a collapsible 'Transitive Dependencies' folder (recommended)
Show only explicit dependencies declared in the project manifest
Show all packages in a flat list
pixi.packages.displayMode.description: Control how installed packages are displayed in the Environments tree view.

enumDescriptions: Group project view by environment and display installed packages (default)
Group project view by declared feature and display declared dependencies
pixi.environments.viewMode.description: Control how the Environments tree view is organized: by environment or by feature.

pixi.cache.autoMeasureSize.description: Automatically compute the disk size of Pixi/Rattler cache directories in the Pixi Info view.

enumDescriptions: Group tasks by their default environment (e.g. 'dev', 'test', 'pkg')
Display tasks in a flat list without grouping
pixi.tasks.groupBy.description: Specifies how tasks are grouped in the Pixi Tasks tree view.

pixi.tasks.prefixSeparators.description: Characters used to extract namespace prefixes from task names.

pixi.tasks.minGroupSize.description: Minimum number of tasks sharing a prefix required to form a group folder. Isolated tasks below this count stay at the root level.

pixi.tasks.maxDepth.description: Maximum nesting depth for prefix-based task groups (1 keeps subtasks flat under the top-level prefix, 2 allows one level of sub-groups).

enumDescriptions: Hover Tooltips (Default): Show task command details and run links when hovering over task names. Zero line insertions, cleanest layout.
Compact CodeLens: Show a single compact inline button (e.g. '▶ Run (dev)') above each task.
Full CodeLens: Show full inline buttons ('▶ Run Task' and '⚙ Run in Environment...') above each task.
Header CodeLens: Show an aggregated run action above the [tasks] section header only.
Off: Disable all in-editor task run actions in manifests.
pixi.tasks.manifestActions.description: Specifies how interactive task actions are presented in pixi.toml and pyproject.toml manifests.

pixi.dependencies.inlayHints.description: Show locked dependency versions as inline hints in pixi.toml and pyproject.toml manifests.

pixi.manifest.schemaSupport.description: Enable offline schema-based autocompletion and hover documentation in pixi.toml and pyproject.toml manifests.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
